title: Waiting Period for Guns by State

sources.name: Which states require a waiting period before gun purchases? - Everytown Research
When it comes to gun purchases, just 9 states and D.C. have waiting periods. Among those who don’t: the federal government - Fortune

_: Wait applies to all firearms. Duration is three days or the time it takes to complete required background checks, whichever is longer
Wait applies to all firearms. Duration is 10 days for semiautomatic rifles, the lesser of 3 days or until background check completes for other gun types
Wait applies to handguns and assault weapons
Wait applies to all firearms. Wait is waived for law enforcement officials. After seven days, sale must be completed unless background check disqualifies it.
